## Argv0Resolution.assignmentsSkipped property

The number of `VAR=val` shell-assignment prefixes on the `CallExpr` itself (`CommandSite.node.Assigns`<!-- -->, e.g. the `FOO=bar` in `FOO=bar rm x`<!-- -->) that were skipped to reach argv0. This is a distinct mechanism from a wrapper's own `VAR=val` \*operands\* (e.g. `env`<!-- -->'s or `sudo`<!-- -->'s, see [WrapperSpec.assignmentOperands](./sh-analysis.wrapperspec.assignmentoperands.md)<!-- -->) — always exactly `CommandSite.node.Assigns`<!-- -->'s length, independent of the wrapper chain found afterward.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly assignmentsSkipped: number;
```
